title: Organic fibrous nanostructures via the droplet-assisted growth and shaping (DAGS) mechanism
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23045-23053
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01919B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rabab Azizi, Stefan Seeger
This study unveils the formation of organic fibrous nanostructures via the DAGS mechanism, achieved by polymerising ECA in solution with water, demonstrating a novel approach to synthesise versatile 1D nanomaterials.
